name: Deore XT rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 270 g for the RD-M732-SGS super-long-cage seven-speed assembly, not another cage version. The documented 28–32T largest-sprocket range depends on Shimano SFR/SF fork ends; 32T is not an unconditional frame-independent limit.
